name: quiet-tools
description: Replaces diffs, Bash commands and tool output with one short line (ctrl+o shows everything)

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Marker at the start of each folded tool line. Leave empty for none.

verbColor.title: Verb color
verbColor.description: Color of the verb (Cmd, Edited, Read...): a theme color such as suggestion, success, warning, claude, or a name or hex like cyan or #5fafff. Empty = dim like the rest.

label.title: Command label
label.description: What folded shell calls show: the short description the model wrote for the command (falls back to the command), or the command itself.

showCommand.title: Show command
showCommand.description: Show a short version of Bash/PowerShell commands, e.g. Cmd: sed -i ... README.md (used when label is command or the call has no description)

commandMaxChars.title: Text length
commandMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of the description or command shown (minimum 10).

showLineCount.title: Show line count
showLineCount.description: Append the number of output lines, e.g. (24 lines), to folded Bash calls.

showDiffSize.title: Show diff size
showDiffSize.description: Append added and removed lines to edits, e.g. Edited src/a.ts (+3 −1).
